title: Food Service Sales Representative
description:
Food Service Sales Representative

Permanent Salary up to 40,000 DOE

Location: Blandford Forum DT11 7 SX

Help bring luxury confectionery to the food service and hospitality industry.

Our client is a leading UK distributor of premium chocolates and confectionery, is looking for an experienced and driven Food Service Sales Representative to join its growing team.

Following significant growth within the food service division and increasing demand for the products, we are looking for a motivated sales professional to develop new business opportunities and build lasting customer relationships across the sector.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Food Service, you will play a key role in expanding our presence across the food service and hospitality market.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Identifying, developing and securing new customer accounts within your agreed territory.
- Managing and growing relationships with existing customers.
- Building new business opportunities across hotels, restaurants, event companies, cruise lines, charities, corporate organisations and wholesalers.
- Promoting the company's premium chocolate and confectionery range.
- Providing product knowledge, advice and tailored solutions to customers.
- Negotiating commercial opportunities and driving sales growth.
- Working closely with the Head of Food Service to achieve sales targets and business objectives.

About You

We are looking for someone who is commercially minded, proactive and passionate about sales and customer relationships.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Sales Representative or Business Development role within the food service, hospitality or catering industry.
- An established network of contacts within the hospitality and food service sectors.
- Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- A proven ability to identify new business opportunities and win new customers.
- A self-motivated and organised approach, with the ability to work independently.
- A passion for premium products and delivering exceptional customer service.
- A full UK driving licence.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent position.
- Salary up to 40,000 DOE.
- Opportunity to develop and grow within an expanding business.
- The chance to represent a premium portfolio of luxury chocolate and confectionery brands.

Interested?

If you have a background in food service sales and are looking for an opportunity to develop new business and build strong customer relationships, we would love to hear from you.

title: Internal Sales Coordinator (Engineering)
description:
Internal Sales Coordinator (Engineering)

30,000 - 34,000 per annum + Commission + Bonus + Career Development + 31 Days' Holiday (Including Bank Holidays) + Pension

Blandford (commutable from Bournemouth, Poole, and surrounding areas)

Are you an Internal Sales Executive or similar looking to take ownership of your own customer accounts, representing a globally recognised Engineering brand with the opportunity to increase your earnings through Commission?

In this role, you will be responsible for managing and developing existing customer accounts, identifying sales opportunities and generating repeat business across a range of Specialist Machinery parts and accessories. You will predominantly work from the depot, with occasional customer visits to build relationships and develop accounts.

This is an opportunity to join an established Engineering Dealership representing a Globally Recognised Construction machinery brand. Operating across multiple depots, the business offers the opportunity to develop specialist technical knowledge, gain greater commercial responsibility and explore longer-term career opportunities across the wider group.

This role would suit a commercially minded individual looking to develop their career within a Specialist Engineering Business. Previous Engineering or parts experience is not essential.

The Role:
- Manage and develop existing customer accounts.
- Proactively contact existing and previous customers to generate repeat business.
- Provide quotations, negotiate pricing and identify upselling opportunities.
- Coordinate the supply of specialist machinery parts and accessories.
- Monday to Friday, 7:30am - 5:30pm, with alternate Saturdays, 7:30am - 10am (paid additionally).

The Person:
- Background in Internal Sales, Account Management or similar.
- Confident proactively contacting customers and identifying sales opportunities.
- Willingness to develop specialist product knowledge.

The Benefits:
- Greater autonomy and ownership of customer accounts.
- Potential performance-related financial incentives.
- Approximately 60 additional pay per Saturday worked.
- Specialist technical development and longer-term career opportunities.
- 31 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and company pension.

If you are interested in this role, please apply with an up-to-date CV.

This vacancy is being advertised by Roundhouse Recruitment Limited. Roundhouse Recruitment Limited is acting as a recruitment agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Digital Account Manager
description:
Digital Account Manager Bournemouth Hybrid

Take the lead on some of the agency's biggest, highest-value client accounts and be the face they trust.
You'll own the relationship and the results, with specialist PPC, SEO and Paid Social experts delivering alongside you.
This is a visible, high-impact Digital Account Manager role where your recommendations shape where significant budgets go.

As a Digital Account Manager, you will benefit from:
- 30 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Flexitime, with the option to work from home 3 days a week
- Private medical insurance
- Parking or gym membership contribution
- Budget towards events and training courses
- Monthly team lunches and quarterly team-building days
- A casual dress code and a central Bournemouth office close to shops, cafés and the beach
- Real long-term career progression in a close-knit, growing agency

As a Digital Account Manager, your responsibilities will include:
- Owning and growing relationships with a portfolio of larger, high-retainer client accounts
- Leading client meetings, performance reviews and regular updates with confidence
- Overseeing SEO, PPC and Paid Social performance, with a particular focus on PPC budgets and spend
- Turning data and specialist insight into clear, commercially focused recommendations
- Working with Account Executives and channel specialists to keep work scoped, prioritised and delivered on time
- Spotting opportunities to grow accounts and supporting pitches, audits and new business activity

As a Digital Account Manager, your experience will include:
- Strong experience in a client-facing role within a digital marketing agency
- Managing larger client accounts, retainers and budgets
- Strong PPC knowledge (particularly Google Ads), plus a good understanding of SEO and Paid Social
- Confidently discussing KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, conversions and organic performance
- Google Analytics 4 and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
- Google Ads certification and experience with lead generation or ecommerce clients would be a bonus

If you're ready to step up as a Digital Account Manager, own the client relationship and see the impact of your work on every account, this is the role for you. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Nina Cranidge at Rubicon for more information.

While Rubicon uses AI to help speed up processes across the business, every application is reviewed by a human to ensure the right decision is made.
